envelope.description: The worker's act and the runner's onWaiting

body.title: The worker's act and the runner's onWaiting
body.summary: In chat-queue-worker.ts: ChatQueueWorker gains act(seq, 'cancel' | 'dismiss' | 'resend') -> { ok: true } | { ok: false; note }, applying store.cancel / dismiss / resendFrom(seq, newTurnId(), claim.windowKey), catching StoreBusy / unavailable into a note, and ticking at once on success (AMD-3). QueuedTurnRunner.run gains the optional onWaiting argument; runMessage passes a handler that writes markWaiting(message.seq, on), keeping the latest value to write again on the next tick if the write fails (AMD-8).
acceptanceChecks: act cancel removes a waiting message and is refused with a note once it has started; dismiss and resend likewise refuse rows in the wrong state
act resend hands the message to this window's key
An act that succeeds is seen by an onChange listener without waiting for a poll
onWaiting from the runner sets and clears waitingOn on the running message's row; a busy write is retried on the next tick

tests.name: worker act: cancel removes a waiting message and is refused once the message has started; dismiss and resend refuse rows in the wrong state; resend takes this window's key; a successful act is seen by onChange at once
worker onWaiting: the runner's card report sets and clears waitingOn on the running message, and a busy write is retried on the next tick
